summary: Go to chat, like an editor's Go to File but for chats. Desktop: Mod+P (`app.go-to-chat`, rebindable in Settings > Keyboard) opens a dialog over every chat the sidebar lists (local projects read fresh with app:get-projects on each open, plus each remote machine's projects from the machine store) and the local archived chats. With nothing typed it shows Recent (the newest 5 by last activity) then All chats. A query matches titles and project names only, never message text: exact title, then title starts with, then title contains, then project name contains, newest first inside each tier; the matched part of the title is highlighted. Archived chats appear only when the query holds the word archive or archived, which is then not matched, and their rows say archived. Enter opens the chat in the focused slot through the sidebar's open path (a remote chat opens on its own machine); Mod+Enter opens it beside, through the sidebar's Open beside path. The rules live in src/shared/chat-search.ts. Both phones' per-project chat lists rank their existing search box with the same rules; an empty box shows the list as before.

storageDataMigration.reason: No table, column, setting or migration. app:get-archived-conversations now also returns the existing agent_type and origin_source columns; the archived settings page ignores them, and the dialog treats a row without them (an older backend) as a Claude chat.
